request: A spur gear with 20 teeth for a 5 mm D shaft that meshes with my existing 40 tooth gear. Their shafts are 30 mm apart. Plain straight teeth.
sources: KHK Gear Technical Reference, Calculation of Gear Dimensions: center distance a = m (z1 + z2) / 2 for standard spur gears
note: m = 2 x 30 / (20 + 40) = 1.0 mm. The bore is the shaft plus a printing clearance.
